items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: S5 bullets, fold order, cap 20 plus N more, folded+pending checks, conventions-reviewed, prompt scan, docs and release note all present

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: fold keeps files on write error or anchor conflict; aggregate fails closed on a failed bullet fold

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: bullet names validated by grammar, single-line enforced, prompt scan without allowlist marker, O_EXCL writes

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: real git merge-tree, real fold bytes, by-path loader, base-side pending, conflicts

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: pending scan is one directory listing; base side costs one ls-tree plus one git show per base bullet

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: files under 300 LOC, bloat baselines not raised

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: producer write_doc_bullet to consumers fold/effective_text proven by byte-equal round trip and the compliance by-path loader test
